data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Berenike, meaning ‘Bringer of Victory’, itself derived from the Hebrew name Biryniy, meaning ‘Exalted, Ruler, Shining One’. The name Berenice was borne by several ancient Greek and Roman saint. The name Berenice carries the meaning “Bright, shining one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Berenice usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, shining one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_english.name: Berenice
in_english.meaning: a name of Greek origin, meaning 'she who brings victory' or 'bringer of light', with various interpretations
in_english.long_meaning: derived from the Greek words 'berenikē', with 'berenikē' meaning 'she who brings victory' or 'bringer of light', and associated with the Ptolemaic queen Berenice II, who was known for her beauty and her influence on the development of Ptolemaic Egypt. In Christian tradition, the name Berenice is linked to the saint Berenice, who was a patron saint of Sicily. The name has been used in various cultures, including Greek, Latin, and English, with different interpretations and connotations. In biblical studies, the name Berenice is associated with the queen of Syria, who is mentioned in the New Testament as a patron of the apostle Paul.

data.cultural_impact: The name Berenice has been popular throughout history, across various cultures. Ancient Roman and Greek saints bearing this name have influenced the Christian faith significantly, particularly in art and literature. The depiction of Saint Berenice, a martyr and virgin, in Christian art showcases virtues such as courage, purity, and resilience.
data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, Berenice holds a deep spiritual meaning as a reminder of steadfast faith and devotion to God. The name reveals the expectation of providence and victory, representing the belief in the triumph of good over evil. Berenice embodies the virtues of courage, purity, and strength in the face of adversity and provides emotional inspiration to those who bear the name or are touched by its story.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Berenice, derived from Bereniké in Greek, means "bringer of victory," symbolizing the strength and triumph of faith in the face of adversity. It is a name rooted in the spiritual journey of devotion and resilience.
